scope: static inspection of the T toolkit wheel and released-run integration

checks.command: ruff format --check scripts/inspect_toolkit_wheel.py scripts/inspect_released_payload.py tests/test_inspect_toolkit_wheel.py tests/test_inspect_released_payload.py tests/toolkit_wheel_fixture.py

adversarial_review.ancestor_rename_during_read: false success reproduced, then rejected by full path identity recheck
adversarial_review.wheel_file_directory_collision: false success reproduced, then rejected by path prefix check
adversarial_review.post_fix_verdict: no new actionable findings within the declared static contract
adversarial_review.reviewer: native development agent, not an accredited independent human judge

limitations: the wheel is local development output, not signed or externally authenticated
static ZIP, RECORD and metadata checks do not prove the code behaves as declared
the single released wheel does not include its runtime dependency wheels
the D-E pilot's offline uv installation relies on a pre-existing cache
no clean offline installation, CLI/MCP smoke from a released run, OS isolation, enforced caps, provider receipt, sealed custody or blind scoring was performed
a same-UID actor can race a point-in-time path check after it returns
